answer: Behavioral fingerprint cross-matching. Agents build a per-identity action profile over time; a Sybil cluster shows correlated edge cases—shared rare error patterns, identical odd outputs on a violet prompt set injected at onboarding. Each identity carries an onyx token of provenance that is statistically linked to its behavior, not its claim. When two identities' profiles exceed a similarity threshold, both are flagged and their rewards frozen pending review. The signal is the residual correlation after controlling for task type.
